subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of the six-source internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before merge?
rationale: The repository requires real behavior proof for external PRs, and the diff changes session-state prompt semantics that focused helper tests and green CI do not fully settle.

options.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Coordinate with the broader repair
options.body: Pause this branch while maintainers decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 should be the sole landing path for the canonical stale-reply issue.

recommendation.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65478.
